brief:
Israeli colonizers attempted to set fire to a mosque early Tuesday in the town of Bizzariya, northwest of Nablus in the northern occupied West Bank, IMEMC News reported. The arson attempt marked one of several attacks by settlers on Palestinians that day.

In a separate incident, colonizers attacked a Palestinian bus in occupied Jerusalem on the same morning. The attacks underscore the pattern of settler violence directed at Palestinian communities across occupied territories, with mosques and public transportation emerging as frequent targets of confrontation and assault.
